payload.reason: The deleted test checked that a newer read-back withdraws an older card, but SR-223 now requires that gaps are asked through the question tool, never on a card, and the file's new helper says no card is ever written (SR-382), so the behaviour under test is ruled out rather than merely weakened. The removal is a consequence of the requirement change, though deleting an acceptance test always warrants some suspicion.
